info.name: Coveo Activity Activities Query Configurations API
Get Query Configuration for a Solution

params.name: organizationId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
**Example:** `acmecorporation8tp8wu3`

params.name: trackingId
params.description: The unique identifier of the tracking target.

params.name: solutionType
params.description: The solution type for the rule. It can be either 'listing' or 'search' or 'recommendations'.

params.name: targets
params.description: List of target identifiers e.g. listing page name, slot ID

params.name: isGlobal
params.description: Whether the query configuration is globally applied.

items.docs:
Retrieves the query configuration for a solution (e.g. listing, search) in an [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).

Note: When using the Recommendation solution type, only the `perPage` and `additionalFields` parameters within the query configuration model are supported.

**Required privilege:** Merchandising Hub - View
